youtube.title: Why Pop-Tarts Weren't Kellogg's Idea 🍓 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
In 1963 Post announced a foil-wrapped toaster pastry called Country Squares, using a foil packaging method it had developed for its Gaines-Burgers dog food to keep food fresh without refrigeration. Post announced it before it was ready, and Kellogg's raced its own version to market, launching Pop-Tarts in 1964. The first Pop-Tarts were unfrosted; frosted Pop-Tarts arrived in 1967.
